# Wrist IMU punch classifier - 2026-10-29 test log

Raw Serial Monitor output from `imu_punch_classify_test/imu_punch_classify_test.ino`
after the fix that made `refUp` continuously adaptive instead of a one-time
startup calibration (see that file's header comment and `robot_arm/CLAUDE.md`'s
"Wrist IMU punch detector" section for the full story of how we got here -
two failed gyro-verticality models, then the palm-up-vs-palm-down test that
found the real root cause: forearm roll, not swing plane, was driving
classification).

This run is the first one where classification tracked real punch type
reasonably well across a real mixed sequence of throws. CSV format for each
`PUNCH,...` line:

```
PUNCH,<type>,<angleDeg>,<ms>,<vertSwing>,<vertImpact>,<peakGyroMag>,<refUpX>,<refUpY>,<refUpZ>
```

- `type` - hook / uppercut / punch (straight), what classification decided
- `angleDeg` - accel-direction vs refUp, what classification actually runs on now
- `ms` - time from onset to recognition
- `vertSwing`, `vertImpact` - the two abandoned gyro-verticality measures, comparison only
- `peakGyroMag` - deg/s, also gates the "punch" (straight) fallback
- `refUpX/Y/Z` - the LIVE adaptive reference this specific punch was judged against

Not yet cleaned up or cross-checked against a written-down "I threw hook,
hook, uppercut, ..." order - this is the raw log as it came off Serial
Monitor. Next session: repeat with the throw order written down alongside
so misclassifications can be counted properly, and to confirm `ANGLE_HOOK_MIN_DEG=60.0`
is actually in the right place (several of the angles below land close to it).
